P1.evidence: No setter on this call. Time was set ('I know we've got 45 minutes') and the frame was the fullest version he ran all batch — 'Just get a good idea where you're at. Get the full picture, full context. Build out what it is that you want. If there's alignment, let's talk about the coaching. If not, that's also fine' — but still three parts, with 'what's in the way' omitted. Agreement given, open question asked.

P2.evidence: The best baseline in the batch, and still incomplete. Height and weight were asked directly — 'how much do you weigh right now and how tall are you?' — followed by body fat, but not age. Work was explored properly, including the thing that mattered: 'How frequent are the trips? Does it vary like to extremes?' Diet was interrogated well and then stress-tested for travel: 'And when you travel, does it stay pretty good too?' Health conditions, injuries, sleep and energy were never asked, and the mobility collapse only surfaced because the prospect volunteered it at 00:22:09.

P3.evidence: Ran both horizons deliberately. Short term: 'obviously you want to be in the best shape for your wedding, what do you feel like needs to change from your perspective in terms of aesthetically over those next nine weeks' and then a tangible target ('did you have it in mind, like, a body fat percentage'). Long term: 'What would you say is like the ultimate goal with that for the future?', which produced fatherhood, role-modelling and longevity. The reflect-back was the best moment in the batch: 'What I think is beautiful is that every single goal you have is out of, to make everybody else's life better... It's more than swinging around kettlebells... so you can be the best husband and the best father possible.' He never asked who else it impacts or what changes when he moves better — the prospect supplied both unprompted.

P4.evidence: Asked cleanly and early: 'I know you said you've done a lot of things that haven't stuck... Why do you feel like nothing really stuck for you?' The prospect named the real gap himself — travel, no barbells in hotel gyms, refusal to do his own modifications, and boredom after three months — and the rep summarised it accurately: 'what you have been doing just hasn't been the right vehicle for you to be able to stay consistent.' Only P4f was missing.

P5.evidence: No consequence frame, on a call that closed. Nothing was asked about what two years of the same pattern looks like, no willingness-to-settle question, no line in the sand — despite the prospect handing over the perfect image himself in his six-year-old stepson putting on weight and losing activity. The deadline of a wedding in 68 days did the work the phase is designed to do, which is luck rather than process.

P6.evidence: No commitment check before presenting. The rep moved from 'Any questions on the process?' straight to 'I'll walk you through the next steps, and we can talk numbers'. Neither the belief question nor the all-in question was asked at any point. The only readiness question came after the price and was a close, not a commitment check: 'You ready to rock and roll and get absolutely jacked and shredded for 68 days?'

P11.evidence: The only call in the batch where the money was asked for: 'in terms of the payment, did you want to do it on Visa, MasterCard, credit card?' The onboarding call with Trevor was booked live for Monday 12:15pm Central with an attempt to pull it earlier, and email and phone were captured. The agreement signature and the welcome-email/Skool/questionnaire steps are unobservable — the rep stopped the recorder to take card details before the call ended.

notes: Textbook front half — the strongest baseline, goals and root-cause work of the batch, and the only call where the rep actually asked for the card and booked the onboarding call live. It closed. It also skipped Phase 5 and Phase 6 entirely, and the reason that did not cost anything is that the prospect arrived pre-sold with a wedding 68 days away and no price sensitivity. Score the process, not the outcome: this is a good call with the same two holes as every other call in the batch, and here they simply were not tested.
